Exercise A

A Message from My Grandmother's Kitchen

Read the text, then choose the correct verb form for each gap.

Before you read — optional, not marked
One sentence each is enough.
Read and complete

Hi Maya! I am writing to you from my grandmother's kitchen. On Saturdays I usually work in a bakery, but today I my family.

My grandmother soup right now, and it smells wonderful. She soup every Saturday, and the whole family to her house for lunch.

My brother never in the kitchen. Right now he football in the garden with our cousins. See you on Monday!

Exercise D

Write to a pen friend

Your new pen friend Alex asks: "What do you usually do on weekends, and what are you doing right now?" Write an email of 6–8 sentences (about 60 words) to answer. Use the present simple for your routines at least three times and the present continuous for right now at least twice.

Useful phrases
You can use these: I usually … on Saturdays. My friends and I often … I never … on Sundays. Right now I am … At the moment my family is …
